lead: An invalid `--FILE nvs.toml--` fails the whole case before the program starts: `E0601`/`E0609` on stderr, empty stdout.
body: `boot_snapshot` reads it for real, and `rule:config/a-duplicate-key-is-an-error-and-so-is-an-unknown-one`'s typed tree refuses an `[[app]]` block with no `root` or `entry`, a root-level `origin` and any unknown key. `entry = "nvs.toml"` is a legal key matching no program, the shape a decoy block wants.
